questions.answer: Starting with outcomes from comparable past cases.
questions.feedback: Check the definition and explain it in your own words before retrying.

questions.prompt: Why not choose a class after seeing its success rate?
questions.answer: It risks selecting evidence to support the desired forecast.
questions.feedback: Check the distinction or calculation against the worked case; correct the first unsupported step.

questions.prompt: Can a base rate be adjusted?
questions.answer: Yes, using justified differences and explicit uncertainty.
questions.feedback: State a concrete implication or limitation and retry without notes.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Selects defensible reference classes and explains adjustments and sampling limitations.
scoring.transfer: For three questions from L01, define two plausible reference classes, state which evidence is unavailable, and produce a provisional forecast range with documented reasoning.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; quiz score alone is insufficient.
